requirements.CORE-BUILD-001: The build writes a script-tag bundle to `dist/bio.viz-{version}/bio.viz.js` that defines the global `BioViz`.
requirements.CORE-BUILD-002: The build writes an ES module bundle to `dist/bio.viz-{version}/bio.viz.esm.js` with the same exports as the script-tag bundle.
requirements.CORE-API-001: `version` equals the `version` field of package.json: in the source, in both committed bundles, and as `BioViz.version` on a page that loads the script-tag bundle.
requirements.CORE-DEP-001: package.json declares no runtime dependencies: safety.viz and webR are loaded beside the bundle on a page and are never bundled into it.
requirements.CORE-SITE-001: The site's home page names the library and its version, and shows the version reported by the bundle that page loaded.
requirements.CORE-SITE-002: The site's home page holds at a 390-pixel-wide viewport with no horizontal scroll.
